name: ui-scroll-reveal-feed
title: Scroll Reveal
description: Trang trong khung nhìn cuộn lên, mỗi thẻ trồi lên 20 px và hiện dần khi đi từ mép dưới tới vạch hiện, cuộn ngược thì thẻ vẫn giữ nguyên.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Viewport 136x160: header bars, then 5 cards 114x56 r8 every 80 px (first at y 80). Page scrolls 0→300 px over 0.3-2.3 s (power2.inOut), holds 0.4 s, scrolls back 2.7-3.35 s. Each card's reveal follows its position: from the viewport bottom to a line 84 px below the top it rises +20→0 px and fades 0→1 (outCubic over that 76 px of travel). Plays once: revealed cards stay while scrolling back. Scroll thumb tracks progress. Params: scroll (300 px) · duration (2 s) · rise (20 px) · line: vạch hiện (84 px từ đỉnh) · ease (power2.inOut). Plays once: a card that has been revealed stays while the page scrolls back.
moworks.titleVi: Thẻ hiện dần khi trang cuộn
